sentences.text: My name is Amelie, today we will talk about a beautiful island country.
This country is called Barbados.
Listen carefully and try to understand.
I will speak slowly.
Let's begin.
Where is Barbados?
Barbados is a small island country.
It is in the Caribbean Sea.
It is east of the Caribbean islands and close to South America.
The country is not very big.

It is about 34 kilometers long and 23 kilometers wide.
The capital city of Barbados is Bridgestown.
Many people live in Bridgestown and it is the biggest city in the country.
Barbados has a warm climate.
The weather is sunny and hot for most of the year.
It does not get very cold.
Many tourists come to Barbados because of the beautiful weather.
They enjoy the sun, the beach, and the sea.
What is Barbados famous for?
Barbados is famous for its beautiful beaches.
The water is blue and clear, the sand is soft and white.
Many people go to Barbados for a holiday.

They swim in the sea, relax on the beach, and enjoy the sunshine.
Some people also do water sports.
They surf, dive, and go on boat trips.
Barbados is also famous for its music.
The people love to listen to Calypso and reggae music.
These types of music make people happy.
There are many festivals in Barbados with music, dance, and fun.
A very famous singer from Barbados is Rihanna.
She is a pop star, and people all over the world know her songs.
Food in Barbados.
The food in Barbados is very delicious.
Many dishes have fish, rice, and vegetables.
One popular dish is flying fish and cuckoo.
Flying fish is a special fish in Barbados.
People cook it with spices and serve it with cuckoo.
Cuckoo is made with cornmeal and okra.
It is soft and tasty.
Another popular dish is macaroni pie.
It is like baked pasta with cheese.
It is very creamy and delicious.

People in Barbados also eat a lot of fresh fruit.
They eat mangoes, bananas, and pineapples.
These fruits are sweet and juicy.
Culture and people.
The people in Barbados are friendly.
They smile a lot and like to talk.
They speak English, but their English has a special accent.
This accent is called Beijing English.
Sometimes it is a little different from standard English,
but it is still easy to understand.
Every year, Barbados has a big festival called Crop Over.
This festival happens in the summer.
People wear colorful clothes,
dance in the streets, and play music.
It is a time for fun and celebration.
Many tourists come to Barbados to see this festival.
Nature and animals.
Barbados has beautiful nature.
There are many green forests and gardens.
You can see tropical flowers and tall palm trees.
The island is home to many animals.
One special animal in Barbados is the green monkey.
These monkeys are small and playful.
They live in trees and sometimes come to people's gardens.
Barbados also has caves.
One famous cave is called Harrison's Cave.
This cave has big rocks and clear water inside.
Many people visit the cave
to see the beautiful stones and waterfalls.
Conclusion, Barbados is a wonderful place.
It has warm weather, friendly people,
delicious food, and great music.
The island is full of life and culture.
